name: newtractor-site
description: Site institucional do Grupo New Tractor.

scripts.lint: node --check src/site.mjs && node --check src/group.mjs && node --check src/technical-content.mjs && node --check src/sector-content.mjs && node --check src/component-content.mjs && node --check src/equipment-content.mjs && node --check src/territory-content.mjs && node --check src/hydraulic-content.mjs && node --check src/discovery.mjs && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/hero-video.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check tests/site.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run check && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name newtractor-site --branch preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name newtractor-site --branch main
